purpose: Implement the existing EG-CONCURRENCY and EG-RESOURCE runners for the active xtask tooling scope without application behavior or Qualification Cell advancement.

change.public_seam: cargo xtask quality returned verdict and immutable target/quality/evidence report

dependency_review.rationale: The implementation uses only Rust std bounded sync channels, threads, queues, and existing reviewed xtask dependencies.

runner_changes: The active xtask scope selects only the existing EG-CONCURRENCY and EG-RESOURCE risk gates; all gate IDs, stages, budgets, coordinators, exception classes, cells, and product scopes remain unchanged.

FrozenQualificationFixtures captures concurrency-fixtures.tsv once, binds its bytes into fixture, seed, and schedule identities, and supplies those same immutable bytes to both runners and retained evidence.

EG-CONCURRENCY registers three Quality Engineering workers before Builder::spawn, gives each a one-command bounded channel, cooperative cancellation token, and shared bounded measurement channel, sends only structurally cooperative bounded commands, and records completion only after JoinHandle::is_finished plus join of that exact handle. This private thread owner proves registration, cooperative cancellation, completion, and exact observed joins; it does not host a noncooperative fault. Ordinary worker startup and execution use the unchanged registered EG-CONCURRENCY stage timeout. A distinct monotonic 100ms shutdown clock starts only after timeout, cancellation, or another failure requests reconciliation. Every process-group probe, signal, forced kill, direct-child reap, and applicable broker abort receives that same absolute shutdown deadline without a phase-local reset. The true noncooperative injection lives at the controlled child-process boundary: after a create-new, synced readiness marker, the child process hangs without spawning an unjoinable registered worker, and the parent force-terminates and reaps the direct child and its process group. Retained evidence defines this process-backed runner as exactly one canonical controlled child step, binds that step to the frozen stage timeout, and separately records typed execution and shutdown observations.

On Unix, controlled process-group probes and TERM/KILL signals use the existing pinned rustix 1.1.4 process APIs in-process. The configured platform process-control tool remains an explicit validated and snapshot-bound portability input, but Unix reconciliation does not launch it. The removed controlled-platform-kill-v1 row is therefore a stale spawn-site removal, not a gate, timeout, or detector waiver. Repeated probe and signal phases check the same absolute 100ms shutdown deadline. If process or broker cleanup fails or overruns while handling an execution deadline or cancellation, the originating typed phase remains primary and the cleanup failure is retained as typed secondary reconciliation context; shutdown evidence continues to report the observed process-reaped and live state.

EG-RESOURCE performs real FIFO work admission, two-unit reservations, hard-pressure denial, a two-attempt retry storm bound, reservation release, queue-empty and leak checks, and three observed worker joins. The verifier independently requires exact one-to-one registered worker IDs, exact joined IDs, and unique contiguous schedule slots before deriving fairness from the observed order.

The controlled child serializes measurement-v1 and runs a diagnostic self-check, but that child check cannot pass either gate. The focused parent-owned bounded_measurement_verifier independently parses the raw child record against the parent-captured exact gate descriptor, both frozen scenario and capacity definitions, exact lifecycle-owner spawn identities, and the reconciled controlled-process verdict. It rejects malformed, missing, duplicate, extra, stale, mismatched, or semantically false fields and independently proves concurrency cancellation/join identity and resource count, slot, fairness, retry, reservation, queue, join, and shutdown bounds. Retained evidence binds the explicit parent verdict to stable verifier identity parent-bounded-measurement-verifier-v1, version 1, its registered contract digest, and SHA-256 identities for the gate descriptor, scenario registry, spawn registry, and raw measurement; child self-verification is recorded as diagnostic-only.

concurrency-spawn-sites.tsv declares stable path, symbol, kind, and semantic site IDs. The focused concurrency source-policy module tokenizes production tooling source with comments and literals excluded, masks only complete cfg(test) items before resuming production scanning, resolves simple, grouped, nested, multiline, aliased, typed, parenthesized, and transitively rebound Rust use/value bindings, denies direct generic and imported unbounded spawn or queue primitives, accepts bounded sync-channel aliases and rebindings, and fails closed if observed semantic sites are duplicate, stale, missing, or newly unregistered.

M0-08 public-seam tests are physically separated into scanner-policy, lifecycle/resource, and parent-verifier modules with shared fixture support; the unrelated evidence-staging publication race repair is outside issue 9 and is not part of this policy change.
unchanged: No application, runtime, Metrics, Profiles, replication, clustering, distribution, or provider behavior is added.
Developer evidence remains diagnostic and non-merge-eligible. Every Qualification Cell remains Specified; this harness implementation is Implemented only.
No dependency, unsafe boundary, threshold, timeout, memory declaration, selector, test command, or existing gate behavior is weakened.

detection_gained: Selecting either newly active gate executes a concrete bounded runner and retains a named immutable outcome instead of returning unsupported-runner failure.

An unregistered direct spawn, direct generic unbounded channel, forbidden primitive hidden through a grouped, nested, aliased, or rebound value binding, production spawn after a cfg(test) item, duplicate semantic registration, stale semantic registration, capacity drift, excess retries, pressure bypass, missing cancellation, missing observed join, duplicate or non-contiguous schedule slot, non-FIFO schedule, or residual reservation fails closed through cargo xtask quality.

A syntactically valid child measurement forged after the child diagnostic verifier, including a coupled post-capture registry swap, cannot fabricate a passing gate because the parent independently revalidates the frozen identities, bounds, lifecycle, and scenario semantics.

Unix shutdown no longer creates helper-process startup and reap contention inside the registered 100ms window; the controlled child and owned broker processes remain the only registered process spawn sites for that lifecycle.

The immutable report identifies the frozen scenario, schedule, seed, registered stage execution timeout, distinct shutdown bound and shutdown elapsed time, exact completed and joined worker IDs, cancellation delivery state, controlled process termination and reap state for noncooperative workers, hard pressure, retry limit, leak result, and the digest-bound explicit parent verifier result.

lifecycle_test_map.pass: quality_runs_concurrency_and_resource_through_the_registered_public_seam verifies both passed named outcomes and immutable reports containing the stable parent verifier identity, version, contract digest, input digests, explicit passed verdict, diagnostic-only child classification, and reconciled process lifecycle.
lifecycle_test_map.fail: The focused m0_08_parent_verifier post-verification cases mutate syntactically valid child output only after child-side verification and prove that malformed, missing, duplicate, extra, stale, mismatched, wrong worker identity or slot mapping, wrong count, unfair order, retry-ceiling, missing-join, shutdown-bound, and coupled post-capture registry-swap forgeries retain failed EG-CONCURRENCY or EG-RESOURCE outcomes. Separate copied-source cases remove the earlier child scenario check or source-policy call and prove that the parent itself rejects gate-descriptor, capacity, missing-owner, and extra-owner drift. Existing scanner failures remain closed.
lifecycle_test_map.timeout_and_cancellation: Gate-specific proof: ordinary concurrency work uses the registered gate execution timeout; timeout, cancellation, or another failure starts one absolute monotonic 100ms shutdown deadline shared by in-process rustix process-group probe and signal operations, direct-child reap, and owned broker cleanup. Repeated TERM, probe, KILL, and probe phases receive that same absolute deadline without reset, and the configured process-control helper is not launched on Unix. Cleanup failure remains typed secondary context rather than reclassifying the primary deadline or cancellation. Structurally cooperative registered workers retain cancel-delivered, already-queued, disconnected, completed, exact joined, shutdown elapsed, and live state without admitting a noncooperative thread command. quality_reaps_a_noncooperative_worker_process_inside_the_registered_bound instead hangs the controlled child process after its create-new synced readiness marker, requests cancellation, then proves typed cancellation, termination-requested, process-reaped, shutdown elapsed at most 100ms, and live=0 evidence through the public gate seam.
lifecycle_test_map.retry_and_resource: The resource scenario records hard pressure at capacity two, limits retries to two, releases all reservations, independently requires exact worker identity and unique contiguous schedule slots, and verifies FIFO order and empty queue state.
lifecycle_test_map.missing_tool: Gate-specific proof: these hermetic Rust std runners introduce no external tool dependency. Shared M0-06 proof: environment snapshot and controlled launch-failure tests preserve missing-tool failures before external detector execution.
lifecycle_test_map.malformed: The frozen concurrency fixture parser rejects bounded registry size, header, field-count, finite integer, duplicate gate, and spawn-site violations before execution. The parent measurement verifier separately rejects malformed, empty, missing, duplicate, extra, and noncanonical child fields after execution.
lifecycle_test_map.stale: Gate-specific proof: the stable semantic spawn-site registry must match every observed source marker exactly, so stale or duplicate registrations fail before work runs. The parent measurement verifier rejects stale schema or scenario identities and uses the parent-captured bytes when a child attempts a post-capture registry swap. Shared M0-06 evidence identity checks cover stale revision, command, environment, raw report, and registry digest bindings.

old.result: Before the parent verifier, the controlled child first passed its own verifier, then changed worker 0 from slot 0 to slot 1. cargo xtask quality accepted the syntactically valid forged measurement and the public regression failed because no parent-owned semantic check existed.

new.result: Focused local diagnostics passed after the retained RED proof showed that post-verification child output could fabricate a passing measurement. The settled parent-verifier module passed 17 of 17 focused closed-schema, semantic-tamper, lifecycle-bound, parent-input, and frozen-registry-swap public-seam cases; the separate positive selector passed both gates and their retained verifier bindings. After the retained clean 99f46ea PR attempt exposed two hard-shutdown failures, focused local diagnostics proved that repeated in-process Unix TERM, probe, KILL, and probe phases share the unchanged 100ms deadline without launching the configured platform helper; a TERM-ignoring child was reaped with live=0; and an escaped-descriptor deadline remained primary while carrying nonempty typed secondary cleanup context. Earlier scanner, lifecycle, and resource diagnostics remain local context. These results are not Qualification Evidence and do not establish merge eligibility.

compatibility_and_recovery.compatibility: The cargo xtask quality command and evidence schema remain unchanged. New reports use the existing selected-gate immutable raw-report contract.
